notes.title: Re.dive Wonderland DEMO Update - 250717
notes.notes:
🎮 Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo!

We’ve released an update on Steam, so please make sure to play with the latest build.



Here’s what’s included in this update:

- Story edits and translation review

- New character outfits and cutscene images, with some illustration tweaks

- \[Menu] button added to the bottom-right of the dialogue box

- Loading screens added between scene transitions

- Skill cut-ins and chapter videos updated

- Various bug fixes



⚠️ Please note: save files from previous versions are not compatible with this update.

We kindly ask that you delete your old save data before playing the new version.



Regarding the English translation:

We initially outsourced the translation to an external agency, but we’ve received feedback that there are some quality issues.

Although we’ve done a first pass at reviewing the script internally, as a small indie team, we currently don’t have a dedicated professional translator.

We promise to have the full translation properly reviewed by experts before the official release.

In the meantime, we’d be truly grateful for your understanding and patience.



Thank you again for all your feedback and support—we’re always listening and doing our best to improve. Please continue to look forward to what's coming next!

notes.title: Re.dive Wonderland - Demo release
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587770/68300364d1f86c850ba8568e34f7dcba64a2a394.gif"]Hello, this is Piacere.

The official demo version of Re.dive Wonderland will finally be released today at 6 PM (KST)!

This demo features the early part of the main story, offering over an hour of gameplay. You'll get a first look at the worldbuilding, meet key characters, and experience the emotional tone and narrative style that define the series.

English is supported as well, so we truly hope many of you will enjoy it!
